about.title: About Desanara
about.lead: Desanara is a programme by HIMA Information Systems, SATU University: a catalogue of products from partner villages, with digital mentoring and training for the people who make them.
about.how: Each village has its own page managed by its village admin. Businesses are verified once by the village, then buyers can order their products directly on WhatsApp — no middleman, no commission.
about.pilot: Pilot village: Desa Baros, Arjasari district, Bandung regency.
about.joinTitle: Run a business in a partner village? Register it
about.joinBody: Online registration is on its way. For now, contact your village admin or the HIMASIF team on Instagram

hero.title: Village craft, for all of Indonesia.
hero.subtitle: Find standout products, support local businesses, and order straight from the makers.

1.title: Pick a product
1.body: Browse by village or search by name.

2.title: Chat the seller
2.body: Choose a quantity, then open WhatsApp with your order already written.

3.title: Agree directly
3.body: Payment and delivery are arranged directly with the maker.

verified.title: Village verified
verified.body: Every business is checked and approved by its village admin before it appears.

direct.title: Straight to the maker
direct.body: No middleman and no commission — your money reaches the maker.

mentored.title: Mentored by HIMA SI
mentored.body: SATU University students help each business prepare its products.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The product may no longer be sold, or the link has a typo.

credits.title: Photo credits
credits.lead: Some sample product photos on Desanara come from Wikimedia Commons and are used until businesses upload their own. Thanks to these photographers.
credits.changes: All photos were resized and recompressed to WebP. The Desa Baros logo and photo belong to the Desa Baros village government (partner village).
